In this video Top Gear looks at the most powerful V12 hypercar ever made, the Zenvo Aurora. It comes in two flavours: the lighter, less powerful but track-focused Aurora Agil; and the full-bore, four-wheel drive and 1850hp Aurora Tur. Whichever you pick, at the heart of both is a quad-turbo 6.6-litre V12 that redlines at 9800rpm!
